investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: retained evidence acquired via curl (raw HTTP, no WebFetch/AI-markdown conversion) with a descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser. A plain curl GET immediately exposed the standard Tribe Events REST API. This venue mixes literary and musical programming with no category taxonomy exposed by the API (every sampled record's own 'categories' array was empty) — this package's own collector (ingestion/byron/filter.mjs) applies a bounded, explainable title-keyword filter downstream of acquisition to retain only genuinely music-relevant records, never at the acquisition/investigation layer.
